Five comments

Henry Blood’s

A slow reel composed by Corey Henderson, who travelled extensively.

↳ Posted by Gus Barbary on March 19th, 2017.

Henry Blood’s, X:2

I love this tune of Coreys’, I taught Corey the uilleann pipes over many years at the Koroit Lake School, and I’ll never forget when he and Tommy Carty played to a packed concert in the Koroit Theatre many years ago. Corey played Inisheer and boy did he nail that Air, you could have heard a pin drop whilst he and Tommy played the tune. At the end there was thunderous applause and a standing ovation. I recall Corey had the biggest smile on his face, it was a magic moment I will never forget. I have put Corey’s tune in A minor as to me it brings out the sadness in the tune, I’m sure Corey would approve. May you rest in peace Corey Henderson.

↳ Posted by JACKB on March 19th, 2017.

Henry Blood’s, X:4

I have been smitten by Corey’s beautiful tune, and wanted to play a third part which headed higher up the scale. I hope of have kept his spirit going in the third part.

↳ Posted by JACKB on March 21st, 2017.

Re: Henry Blood’s

What a great tune. It’s not an easy tune on the mandolin. But I want to get it under my fingers. I’m working on it. Then I want to get the character of the tune right.

Jack, I think the C part fits fine.
